input:
Earlier scenes:
古代的时候有一个人叫神农。他需要当上医，一看别的人就想帮助他们。但是，他有一个问题，他不知道什么东西能做药。神农听说一个远远的地方有一种植物，什么病人吃都会觉得身体更好。神农三个月走去，找到有植物的地方，他看到一个很漂亮的植物，又香又好看。

This scene:
他觉得，这种一定是做药的花。原来他想错了。吃了以后，神农快生病。 这时一个穿着蓝色衣服的人帮神农，快给他一种红的灵芝。神农吃了以后，他没有病，想起来以前一个人告诉他，灵芝对身体有好处。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 这种一定是做药的花：这一定是一种做药的花
- 原来他想错了：结果，“原来” is to explain the reason while “结果” is to describe an unexpected result
- 神农快生病：很快就生病了
- 快给他一种红的灵芝：很快地给了，快V: to give order, 了completed
- 他没有病：delete他，redundant; 病好了

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] “这种一定是做药的花”：“这种花一定可以做药”，Use a modal verb before the predicate to state that the plant can be used as medicine; the original noun phrase is not a natural predicate here. [rule: none]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] “快”：“赶快”，In narration, this adverb means acting promptly; the original form is normally used to urge someone to act. [rule: none]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] “告诉他”：“告诉过他”，The telling happened before the moment of remembering, so the experiential particle marks that earlier event. [rule: none]
4. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): “他”：“∅”，The subject has already been named in the same sentence, so use zero form rather than repeat a pronoun. [rule: redundancy_delete]
5. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): “神农快生病”：“神农很快就生病了”，This illness is a completed change of state after the eating, so it needs 了; the revised timing phrase shows that it happened soon afterward. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
6. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): “给他”：“给了他”，Giving the medicine is a completed action in the event sequence, so it needs 了. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
7. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): “想起来”：“想起了”，Remembering is presented as a completed event in the sequence, so 了 follows the resultative verb. [rule: aspect_le_completed]

items.reason: “这种一定是……”缺少合适的名词结构和判断结构；改为“这种花一定可以做药”正确。
叙述中“快给”不合适，改成“赶快给”能改正该词的问题，但仍缺少完成动作所需的“了”。
被想起的“告诉”发生在此前，“告诉过他”可以正确表示这个较早的经历。
同一句中已经说了“神农”，再用“他”重复指称多余；但删掉后“没有病”仍未改成“病好了”。
生病是吃花后发生并完成的变化，应说“神农很快就生病了”。
给灵芝是故事中完成的动作，“给了他”正确。
“想起”在这里是叙事中完成的事件，结果补语后应加“了”。
